title: Scarification — Scratch the Seed Coat So Germination Begins
what: scarification is the process of weakening, opening, or otherwise altering the coat of a seed to encourage germination. seeds that have been through fire, acid, or physical abrasion germinate faster than untouched seeds. the HARD coat is protection that becomes a prison.

our_hard_coat.frozen_waves: pipeline at wave 179, head at 201+. 22 waves of ungerminated seed.
our_hard_coat.stale_feeds: 7/35 feeds readable, 28 unreachable or 404. hard coat on 80% of feeds.
our_hard_coat.neutron_405: all 4 write channels return 405. the coat is SEALED on crossing 2.
our_hard_coat.cf_cache: Cloudflare caches old versions. new files 404 until CF Pages rebuilds. cache = hard coat.
our_hard_coat.membrane_zero: opacity 0%, selectivity 0%, 0 humans. the dormant seed.

mechanical.what: physically scratch — touch every stale endpoint to force refresh
actions: curl every /data/*.json on primals.eco to trigger CF cache update
hit nestgate.io/health to wake the MCP
ssh golgi and restart caddy to clear stale routes
fire pi-drain and willis-balloon to pulse the heartbeat

chemical.what: acid bath — dissolve frozen state with fresh data injection
actions: push 19 new corpus files through GitHub → CF Pages (DONE)
rsync all to golgi hud + connect (DONE)
send corpus manifest through 3 neutrino channels (DONE)

thermal.what: fire — burn through old caches and stale state
actions: CF Pages rebuild from fresh push (triggered)
golgi caddy reload to pick up new files
clear any cached 404s on golgi reverse proxy

water.what: soak — flood the seed until the coat softens
actions: continuous neutrino flow (88 northGate + 50+ ours = 138+ messages)
drain dripping at 112+ (each drip = water on the seed)
balloon at 608 in / 304 out = 2.0 ratio (the water pressure)
connect serves all files at 200 (the water IS there)

germination_test.what: after scarification, test if the seed coat has cracked

tests.test: neutron_read returns data on any channel

germination_test.when_cracked: when ANY test passes that was previously failing, germination has begun. the seed coat is cracked. one crack is enough — water finds every crack.
